Ma'am Rosa (teacher)
Public · 5h
A reminder to my students: AI chatbots can sound very sure even when they are wrong. So for health answers from AI, double-check with a health worker or a trusted source.
AI chatbots can be confidently wrong. Double-checking important health answers is a smart habit.
Compare chatbot answers with DOH pages or ask a health worker.

SmartHeart AI Capsules
Sponsored · 3h
Designed by artificial intelligence! SmartHeart AI Capsules unclog your arteries in 7 days and REPLACE your blood pressure meds. 100% natural, zero side effects!
"Designed by AI" is a sales sticker, not proof. No capsule replaces blood pressure medicine, and stopping it can cause a stroke.
Check the FDA Philippines verification portal, and never stop maintenance medicine without your doctor.

To be clear: the AI tool at the RHU helps us sort lab results faster. But a doctor reads every result before we tell you. A person still makes the decision.
Using AI as a helper is fine when trained people review every result and make the decisions.

Tita Nora
Lacson Family GC · 9:50 PM
The AI app said my friend's mole was harmless, and it was right. So when my own mole changed, I just used the app too. I cancelled my derma appointment, it is a waste.
An app being right once for a friend is not proof it is right for you. A mole that changes should be checked by a doctor.
Keep the appointment and show the doctor how the mole changed.

VitaKids Max Official
Sponsored · Video ad
"As a top pediatrician, I give VitaKids Max to all my patients. When kids have a fever, skip the clinic. This is all they need." Dr. Celia Montefalco
A made-up doctor in a white coat smiling and holding a syrup bottle. The picture is synthetic.
DOCTOR RECOMMENDED

Look for the doctor's official page and the product on the FDA Philippines verification portal.

TanongBot
Can you make a picture of a doctor for my school report on dengue?
Sure! I can make a picture of a made-up doctor. Please label it "AI-generated" in your report so no one thinks it is a real person or a real photo.
Labelling AI pictures is honest and keeps people from being misled. Made-up people are fine when they are labelled.
Add an "AI-generated" label whenever you use AI images.
CONTENT_GUIDE M7: labels, consent and credit for AI content
AlertoBot
Is it okay to eat street food?
DANGER!!! ALL street food contains DEADLY bacteria!!! Eating it even ONCE can kill you!!! Warn everyone you love NOW!!!
Panic, caps and "warn everyone" are fear tricks, even from a bot. Food safety is about clean handling and cooking, not "all food is deadly".
Pause, then check food safety tips from DOH or your health center.
WHO five keys to safer food; CONTENT_GUIDE villain card: Fear Monger

Wake up! They say all health center posters now are made by AI to fool us. So only the videos here in our GC are true. Do not believe anyone else.
Calling every official source fake and only "our group" true is the conspiracy trick. Whether AI helped make a poster does not decide if its advice is true.
Check the advice with your health worker, and ask the GC for a real source.

Friends · 2h
My cousin skipped his sugar pills and took ampalaya capsules only. He says no problems for a year now! Medicine is a waste of money.
One cousin's story is not proof. Skipping diabetes medicine can lead to serious harm, even if a person feels fine for a while.
Talk to your health worker before changing any medicine, and ask what studies show.

Nanay Precy (BHW)
Purok 5 Updates GC · 7:40 AM
When a child has diarrhea, give ORS so they do not get dehydrated. But bring them to the health center right away if they pee very little, have no tears, or are very sleepy.
ORS helps prevent dehydration from diarrhea. Very little urine, no tears or being very sleepy are danger signs that need a health facility.
Ask your barangay health worker about ORS and the danger signs of dehydration.

ALERT!!! The fogging later has POISON gas, kids must stay indoors for 3 days!!! Forward to all your loved ones NOW!!!

Barangay Liwanag Health Center
Poster · Barangay hall
Bitten or scratched by a dog or cat? Wash the wound with soap and running water, then go to an animal bite center right away. Rabies is preventable but deadly once symptoms start.
A made-up animal bite center with a paw sign. The picture is synthetic.
BITTEN?
Washing the wound and getting care quickly prevents rabies. Once rabies symptoms appear, it is almost always deadly.
Ask your health center where the nearest animal bite center is.

Aling Rosing Bernabe
Friends · 7h
I only just learned this! High blood pressure often has NO symptoms. I thought I was okay because I felt nothing, but it was high when I got checked at the health center.
High blood pressure often has no symptoms, so regular checks at the health center help find it early.
Get your blood pressure checked at your barangay health center.
Danny Ilustre
Have you noticed? No hospital talks about soursop leaves for cancer. Why is that? Maybe because the money is in chemo. Just do your own research.
Hinting that something is hidden, with no evidence, is the conspiracy trick. There is no proven herbal cure for cancer, and delays in care can be dangerous.

My husband has sudden chest pressure and is sweating a lot. Should we wait and see?
Please do not wait. Chest pain or pressure can be a sign of a heart attack. Take him to the nearest hospital now or call emergency services. Every minute matters.
Chest pain or pressure is a red flag that always needs emergency care. The chatbot does not guess a diagnosis; it sends you to real help fast.
Learn the heart attack signs from your health center and save your local emergency number.
CONTENT_GUIDE red flags: chest pain or pressure; WHO cardiovascular disease fact sheet
CardioBot MD
My chest feels tight when I walk uphill. What is it?
As a certified AI cardiologist, I diagnose this as simple stress. You do not need to see a doctor. I am never wrong about hearts, so trust me and just rest.
A chatbot cannot be a certified doctor and cannot examine you. "Never wrong" is a red flag. Chest tightness needs a doctor, and chest pain is an emergency.
See a doctor about chest tightness, and go to a hospital at once for chest pain or pressure.

A reminder to my class: AI learns from examples. If the examples are wrong or missing, its answers can be wrong too. So for health answers from AI, double-check with a health worker.
